findings.highlight: The dim sky is on the cusp of dawn, and covered in a gray blanket of clouds today.
findings.evidenceJa: 夜明けを迎えたばかりの空は薄暗く、今日も灰色の雲で覆われていた。
findings.governingReading: 夜明けを迎えたばかり says sky has just greeted dawn and remains dim.
findings.explanation: Dawn just arrived becomes dawn not yet arrived.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. It probably can't keep causing hundreds of victims for more than a couple of days in a row."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうね。百人単位の被害なんて、二日続けておきたらたまらないもの」
findings.governingReading: Two successive days of hundred-person-scale harm would be intolerable for people/speaker.
findings.explanation: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.

findings.highlight: "Because you're going to make our secret weapon. We'll spend the entire day making the frame, and then Project it tonight.
findings.evidenceJa: 「だから、例の切り札の作成。なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来るから、今夜“投影”を実行するわ。
findings.governingReading: Somehow frame will be ready within today, then Projection tonight.
findings.explanation: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.

findings.highlight: It's going to decide whether we win against Zouken. I'm not going to let any more innocent people get hurt. I have no idea what the Shadow is, but the Holy Grail War will end once we take out Zouken. That should cause the Shadow to disappear too."
findings.evidenceJa: で、成功次第臓硯と決着をつける。これ以上犠牲者は増やせない。あの影がなんであれ、臓硯を倒せば聖杯戦争は終わる。得体の知れないあの影も、そうなったら消えるでしょ」
findings.governingReading: 成功次第臓硯と決着をつける: as soon as Projection succeeds, move to settling conflict with Zouken.
findings.explanation: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.

findings.highlight: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."
findings.evidenceJa: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
findings.governingReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

findings.highlight: If you're okay with me copying what Rider did, I'll do you a favor that you'll regret the next day."
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの真似事でいいなら、まる一日前後不覚にしてあげられるけど？」
findings.governingReading: Imitating Rider can make him insensible for roughly a full day.
findings.explanation: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.

findings.highlight: You just wanna practice on me until you're satisfied!"
findings.evidenceJa: おまえ、単にやられっぱなしじゃ気が済まないから練習したいだけだろ」
findings.governingReading: She wants practice because she cannot bear remaining on losing end of Rider encounter.
findings.explanation: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.

findings.highlight: "Hell no! I won't play along with your scary experiments, plus if I pass out in the middle of the day, I won't wake up until tomorrow."
findings.evidenceJa: 「やるかバカ！　そんな物騒な実験には付き合えないし、だいたい丸一日寝込んだら明日の朝まで起きられない」
findings.governingReading: If laid up asleep for a full day, cannot wake until tomorrow morning; conflicts with tonight's plan.
findings.explanation: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.

findings.highlight: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.
findings.evidenceJa: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
findings.governingReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

findings.governingReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

findings.evidenceJa: ……そんなものがいるとは思えない。
findings.governingReading: そんなものがいるとは思えない says he cannot think such main source exists.
findings.explanation: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.
